held_out_status: The new frozen judge has not been run on Test40.

judge.temperature: provider default; temperature is not accepted with reasoning_effort
judge.stochasticity_disclosure: The reasoning API does not guarantee bitwise repeatability. Raw judge responses are retained; mirrored judgments and clustered bootstrap quantify evaluation variability.

L1.5.name: claim-level citation-support sanity check
L1.5.context_policy: All complete original final chunks are supplied; no post-hoc retrieval and no gold.
L1.5.citation_policy: Cited chunks are judged jointly per material claim; redundant citations need not each entail the whole claim.

L2.name: citation-blind answer-quality comparison V2
L2.gold_payload_policy: Evidence IDs and decoy records are removed. Required and optional gold are supporting evidence; negative gold defines limitations or counterexamples.
L2.identity_leakage_gate: Every citation-stripped answer must pass the deterministic production leakage scan before any API call.
L2.schema_policy: Exact JSON keys and values are required. No schema repair or misspelling alias is permitted.
L2.finish_policy: Only responses with finish_reason=stop are accepted.
L2.raw_vote_policy: All mapped A, B, and tie votes enter the model as separate observations.

aggregation.tie_parameter: one independently estimated nu per criterion, refit in every bootstrap replicate
aggregation.numerical_regularization: A fixed 1e-6 L2 penalty on free log-ability and log-tie parameters is used only to stabilize optimization and is applied identically to point and bootstrap fits.

uncertainty.joint_resampling: The same sampled question list is used for every criterion within a replicate.
uncertainty.failure_policy: Failed fits are omitted and their count and rate are reported.
uncertainty.composite_policy: The descriptive composite is recomputed inside every successful replicate.

anonymization_audit.decision: No statistically detectable above-chance system-identity inference.
anonymization_audit.interpretation_limit: Failure to reject chance is not proof that identity is impossible to infer.
